description: SvTabs in Svelte 5 as a settings screen: line tabs with real panels and a disabled tab, plus a pill-style view switcher. Focus roves between tabs with the arrow keys and activation is automatic, following the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern, with the active tab bound through bind:value.

faq.question: How do I disable a tab?
faq.answer: Set disabled on its entry in tabs. It stays visible, is skipped by arrow-key navigation and cannot be activated.

faq.question: What is automatic activation?
faq.answer: Moving focus with the arrow keys also selects the tab, so keyboard users do not need a second key press; the panel changes as focus moves.

faq.question: How do I switch to the pill look?
faq.answer: Set variant='pill'. The tabs render as a segmented pill group instead of an underlined row, with the same behaviour.
